name: Aoba Risa
source:
A second year JK attending a school in the city. She has a bit of a moody side, but is cheerful, friendly, and is very considerate to others. Has no boyfriend at the moment. 

As long as it feels good, she's fine with almost anything. Doesn't care much about looks, rather she stresses the importance of body affinity.

Her preference recently is hunting virgins, and just as she was finding someone to "play" with, the protagonist who became her seatmate caught her eyes. 

[Translated from [url=http://www.frailsoft.com/products/frail003/index.html#character]Official Site[/url]]
